user.title: Add a MoonLight device
user.description: A host name, an address, or an http:// or https:// URL with no path. Leave the port blank to use 80, or 443 when the URL is https. A number in the port field replaces that port.

data_description.port: Replaces the port from the URL. Blank uses 80, or 443 for https.

wled.title: WLED already discovered this device
wled.description: Home Assistant's WLED integration also finds {host}, because the board advertises _wled._tcp. Adding MoonLight as well creates a second light. Ignore that WLED discovery, or remove the WLED entry, when this device should be MoonLight only.

reconfigure.title: Update the address
reconfigure.description: A host name, an address, or an http:// or https:// URL with no path. The MAC must be the device this entry already is. Leave the port blank to use 80, or 443 when the URL is https.

data_description.port: Replaces the port from the URL. Blank uses 80, or 443 for https.

error.cannot_connect: MoonLight did not answer. Check the host and port, and that the device is on.
error.invalid_response: The host answered, but not with MoonLight's API. A board uses port 80. A computer uses port 8080.
error.invalid_host: Enter a host name, an address, or an http:// or https:// URL with no path.
error.invalid_port: The port must be from 1 to 65535.
error.unknown: MoonLight could not be read. The log has the reason.

abort.already_configured: This device is already added. Its address is updated.
abort.invalid_response: The host answered, but not with MoonLight's API.
abort.invalid_host: The discovered address is not usable.
abort.invalid_port: The discovered port is not usable.
abort.wrong_device: That address is a different MoonLight device. Add it as a new device.

init.title: MoonLight options
init.description: Control is always shown. Turn a page on to add its device. System includes factory reset and the settings that can take the device off the network. Expert mode allows factory reset and formatting the SD card. Those buttons stay disabled until you enable each one on the device page.

data_description.show_system: Includes factory reset, the filesystem, and settings that can take the device off the network.
data_description.expert_mode: Required before a factory reset or an SD card format. The button must also be enabled on the device page.

not_connected.message: MoonLight is not connected, so the change was not sent. {error}

request_failed.message: MoonLight did not accept the change. {error}

expert_required.message: Turn on Expert mode in the MoonLight options before {module} {control}. Then enable the button on the device page.
